liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds the Shakedown excellent and prefers it to the 6/30/85 version; Reviewer counts this among favorite Shakedowns, and also favorite Tom Thumb's, of all time [15][19][24]
- **Just Like Tom Thumb's Blues** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this their favorite Tom Thumb's ever, loving Phil shouting Jerry's name before the guitar solo; Phil wailed out the lyrics on this Tom Thumb's [15][20]
- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Reviewer considers this Black Peter one of the best versions out there and rarely discussed; Reviewer singles out an excellent Black Peter after Space as part of the show's strong second half [18][25]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-11-05.143430.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 160 min [1]. Said about its sound: Tennessee Jed has a couple of odd-sounding spots, also present in the other circulating source and audience tapes; wow and flutter in Don't Need Love was repaired [1]
- **gd1985-11-05.167576.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 162 min [2]
- **gd1985-11-05.151997.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 159 min [4]
- **gd85-11-05.sbd.lai.1188.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 151 min; rated 3.83/5 by 23 [6]
- **gd85-11-05.aud-oade.21246.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 161 min; rated 3.43/5 by 14 [12]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says this Oade audience recording is the best of his work heard, with evident effort in its preparation; Reviewer finds the Oade audience recording preferable to most soundboards, capturing Phil's thundering bass well in a large room [19][26]

## Around the show

- Bill Walton, Danny Ainge and Larry Bird were on stage; Bobby sang Happy Birthday to Walton opening set two [20]
- Sudden wild applause during Brokedown Palace came from a fan who ran onstage and hugged Jerry [21]
- Reviewer, in the front row, noticed a small woman holding a white towel throughout the show [22]
- Reviewer recalls the girl with the towel; it sat on Jerry's back and the person removing it laughed [24]
- Reviewer prefers this Shakedown Street to the one from 6/30/85 [15]
- Reviewer attended both shows; says the Merriweather Shakedown was rawer and rockier than this one, which is still very good [17]
- Reviewer wonders whether this show beats 6/30 but says it burned from first note to last [21]
- Reviewer ranks this Shakedown Street as the year's favorite, better than 6/30 [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-11-05.143430.sbd.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.flac1648**: taped by Rich Gastwirt; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: sbd > cassette master > reel > dat (48k) - Provided by Rich Gastwirt [1]. Also: Soundboard-based FLAC; the opening Happy Birthday Bill Walton seconds come from shnid 126336, and Good Lovin' ending is patched from shnid 21246 [1]
- **gd1985-11-05.167576.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [2]
- **gd1985-11-05.151997.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes (Floor, Section 5, Row 1, Seat 9); Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [4]
- **gd85-11-05.sbd.lai.1188.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: Soundboard [6]. Also: Soundboard lineage: reel master to cassette to DAT to CDR, via Mike Lai [6]
- **gd85-11-05.aud-oade.21246.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Oades; transferred by Oades and Conrad; source: Audience (Schoeps CMC441) [12]
